<b>{{PAGENAME}}</b> is a non-consumable beverage, crafted at the [[alcohol distiller]] from the output of either fruit [[Fermentation|fermentation]] or [[Wine making barrel|wine making barrels]]. On use, it will drop {{Item|Alcohol|15}}, which has its uses in [[alchemy]] as a reagent. Also you have to get one for [[Dig]] in a [[Stranger sins]] quest.

==Trading==
With the DLC ''[[Stranger sins|Stranger Sins]]'', booze - as with most beverages - may be sold regularly, either passively by being stored in the [[Talking Skull]]s cellar, or actively by being stored in the [[Barman]]s inventory and triggering an event.

Each booze sells {{Money|150}}.
